decision: Reject the claim that ordinary-visit sampling makes the gate safe: certified regressions remain. This is not a claim of worse average strength.
proposal: Retain the archived mixed-policy eligibility gate, additionally requiring an available margin to exceed 0.02. When it passes, sample from eligible ordinary visit counts, excluding forced joint probes. Otherwise preserve the same-run pure fallback. Broad adaptive records retain their archived gate decision.
scope: Offline selection-rule ablation on the same search tree; no default bot change. Loss intervals use all opposing root actions and optimal subsequent full-state play, computed with rational arithmetic on padded stored bounds. They do not certify blind information-set or whole-game policies. Repeated states, seeds, budgets and related tactical roots are not independent games or a population guarantee. Empirical seed distributions assign equal weight to the recorded seeds only. An unresolved interval is not evidence of safety. This comparison does not isolate the effect of probing itself.
